description: Use Agent Guild before an agent delegates work, trusts a machine identity, accepts an offer, or signs an x402/crypto payment. It vets counterparties, verifies signed passports and private-message receipts, records outcomes, and supports escrow. On first use, fetch the public manifest once.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
